items.headline: Flood Advisory issued November 26 at 7:16AM EST until November 26 at 10:15AM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southwestern Carteret County in eastern North Carolina...
Southern Craven County in eastern North Carolina...
Eastern Jones County in eastern North Carolina...
Northeastern Onslow County in eastern North Carolina...
Southwestern Pamlico County in eastern North Carolina...

* WHEN...Until 1015 AM EST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways. River or stream flows are elevated.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 716 AM EST, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain. Minor flooding
is ongoing or expected to begin shortly in the advisory area.
Between 3 and 6 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 1.5 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
New Bern, Havelock, Morehead City, Newport, James City, Trent
Woods, River Bend, Stella, Swansboro, South River, Cape Carteret,
North River, Merrimon, Pine Knoll Shores, Harlowe, Maysville,
Silverdale, Tuscarora, Croatan and Riverdale.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
items.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 26 at 5:56AM EST until November 26 at 10:00AM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* WHERE...Beaufort, Coastal Onslow, Mainland Dare, Mainland Hyde,
Pamlico, Southern Craven, Tyrrell, and West Carteret Counties.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM EST this morning.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 26 at 5:31AM EST until November 26 at 4:00PM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, up to 3 feet of
inundation above ground level expected in low-lying areas near
shorelines and tidal waterways. For the High Surf Advisory,
large breaking waves of 6 to 9 feet expected in the surf zone.

* WHERE...West Carteret and Coastal Onslow Counties.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 4 PM EST
Thursday. For the High Surf Advisory, from 7 PM this evening
to 7 PM EST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Up to 3 feet of inundation above ground level is
possible in some areas near shorelines and tidal waterways
resulting in an elevated threat of property damage. Flooding
will extend inland from the waterfront threatening some homes
and businesses. Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and
localized beach erosion.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The higher of the high tide cycles will
be during the morning hours each day this week. The worst
impacts are currently forecast with the morning high tide
cycle on Thursday.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Inexperienced swimmers should remain out of the water due to
dangerous surf conditions.

items.headline: Flood Watch issued November 25 at 11:48PM EST until November 26 at 1:00PM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...A portion of eastern North Carolina, including the
following areas, Beaufort, Coastal Onslow, East Carteret, Hatteras
Island, Inland Onslow, Jones, Mainland Dare, Mainland Hyde,
Northern Craven, Northern Outer Banks, Ocracoke Island, Pamlico,
Southern Craven, Tyrrell, Washington and West Carteret.

* WHEN...Through early Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Flooding may occur in poor drainage and urban areas. Storm drains
and ditches may become clogged with debris.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Rainfall totals of 4 to 6 inches are forecast, with locally
higher amounts possible especially near the Crystal Coast and
southern Outer Banks.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
items.instruction:
You should monitor later forecasts and be alert for possible Flood
Warnings. Those living in areas prone to flooding should be prepared
to take action should flooding develop.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued November 26 at 6:08AM EST until November 27 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and
seas 12 to 17 ft.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Ocracoke Inlet to Surf City.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
